## Country-level indicators

### Datasets

```{r my-datasets}
Post_communist <- tibble::tribble(
  ~Country_code, ~Post_communist,
  "BE", 0, "DK", 0, "GR", 0, "ES", 0, "FI", 0, 
  "FR", 0, "IE", 0, "IT", 0, "LU", 0, "NL", 0, 
  "AT", 0, "PT", 0, "SE", 0, "GB", 0, "CY", 0, 
  "MT", 0, "DE", NA, "DE-W", 0, "BG", 1, "CZ", 1, 
  "EE", 1, "HU", 1, "LV", 1, "LT", 1, "PL", 1, 
  "RO", 1, "SK", 1, "SI", 1, "HR", 1, "DE-E", 1

Post_communist

Pop_Eurostat <- read_csv(here("data", "raw", "Population_2019_Eurostat.csv"))

Pop_Eurostat


#-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

GDP_Eurostat <- read_csv(here("data", "raw", "GDP_2019_Eurostat.csv")) |>
  filter(TIME_PERIOD == 2019) |>
  select(
    Country_code = geo,
    GDP_MEUR = OBS_VALUE
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Country_code = case_when(
      Country_code == "EL" ~ "GR",
      Country_code == "UK" ~ "GB",
      TRUE ~ Country_code
    )
  )

GDP_Eurostat

#-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Roma_population <- read_excel(here("data", "raw", "Estimates_and_official_numbers_of_Roma_in_Europe updated July 2012.xls"), range = "A3:H55")|>
  select(Country_name =Country, Roma_prct_pop= "Average estimate as a") |> 
  drop_na() |> 
  mutate(
    Country_name = case_when(
      Country_name == "Czech Republic" ~ "Czechia",
      Country_name == "Slovak Republic" ~ "Slovakia",
      Country_name == "the Netherlands" ~ "Netherlands",
      TRUE ~ Country_name
    )) |> 
  mutate(
    Roma_prct_pop = round(as.numeric(Roma_prct_pop) * 100, 2)
  )


Roma_population


#-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Gini_Eurostat <- read_csv(here("data", "raw", "Gini_Eurostat.csv")) |>
  filter(TIME_PERIOD == 2019) |>
  select(
    Country_name = geo,
    Gini_coef = OBS_VALUE
  )

Gini_Eurostat


#-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

PISA <- read_csv(here("data", "raw", "academic-performance.csv")) |>
  filter(
    (Year == 2018) |
    (Entity == "Spain" & Year == 2015)
  ) |>
  select(
    Country_name = Entity,
    PISA_reading = Reading
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Country_name = case_when(
      Country_name == "Czech Republic" ~ "Czechia",
      Country_name == "Slovak Republic" ~ "Slovakia",
      TRUE ~ Country_name
    )
  )

# duplicar Alemania para West/East Germany
germany_pisa <- PISA |> filter(Country_name == "Germany")

PISA <- bind_rows(
  PISA,
  germany_pisa |> mutate(Country_name = "West Germany"),
  germany_pisa |> mutate(Country_name = "East Germany")
)

PISA
```

### Country_mapping

```{r}
EU_countries <- tibble::tribble(
  ~Country_code, ~Country_name,
  "BE", "Belgium", "DK", "Denmark", "GR", "Greece", 
  "ES", "Spain", "FI", "Finland", "FR", "France", 
  "IE", "Ireland", "IT", "Italy", "LU", "Luxembourg", 
  "NL", "Netherlands", "AT", "Austria", "PT", "Portugal", 
  "SE", "Sweden", "GB", "United Kingdom", "BG", "Bulgaria", 
  "CY", "Cyprus", "CZ", "Czechia", "EE", "Estonia", 
  "HU", "Hungary", "LV", "Latvia", "LT", "Lithuania", 
  "MT", "Malta", "PL", "Poland", "RO", "Romania", 
  "SK", "Slovakia", "SI", "Slovenia", "HR", "Croatia", 
  "DE", "Germany", "DE-W", "West Germany", "DE-E", "East Germany"
)
```

### Join datasets

```{r}
Country_indicators_tb <- EU_countries |>
  left_join(Post_communist, by = "Country_code") |> 
  left_join(Pop_Eurostat, by = "Country_name") |>
  left_join(GDP_Eurostat, by = "Country_code") |>
  left_join(Roma_population, by = "Country_name") |> 
  left_join(Gini_Eurostat, by = "Country_name") |>
  left_join(PISA, by = "Country_name")

Country_indicators_tb

setdiff(EU_countries$Country_name, PISA$Country_name)
```

```{r my-granular_germany_pop}

# https://www-genesis.destatis.de/datenbank/online/statistic/12411/table/12411-0010

west_states <- c("Schleswig-Holstein", "Hamburg", "Bremen", "Niedersachsen", 
                 "Nordrhein-Westfalen", "Hessen", "Rheinland-Pfalz", 
                 "Saarland", "Baden-Württemberg", "Bayern")

east_states <- c("Mecklenburg-Vorpommern", "Brandenburg", "Berlin", 
                 "Sachsen-Anhalt", "Sachsen", "Thüringen")


Population_federated_states <- read_csv2(file = here("data", "raw", "Population_federated_states.csv")) |> 
  # Filter for the end-of-year 2018 population because the eurostat data was january first 2019
  filter(time == "2018-12-31") |> 
  select(State = "1_variable_attribute_label", Population = "value") |> 
  # Classify into West (DE-W) and East (DE-E)
  mutate(Country_code = case_when(
    State %in% west_states ~ "DE-W",
    State %in% east_states ~ "DE-E",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )) |> 
  # Aggregate population by the new historical regions
  group_by(Country_code) |> 
  summarize(Population = sum(Population, na.rm = TRUE))

Country_indicators_tb <- 
  Country_indicators_tb |> 
  left_join(Population_federated_states, by = "Country_code") |>
  # Merge the new German populations into the primary Population column:
  mutate(Population = coalesce(Population.x, Population.y)) |>
  select(-Population.x, -Population.y)
```

### Add Roma population

```{r}
Country_indicators_tb <- Country_indicators_tb |> 
  mutate(Roma_population = 
           round(Population*Roma_prct_pop/100), .after =Population)

Country_indicators_tb
```

### Add GDP percap

```{r}
Country_indicators_tb <- Country_indicators_tb |>
  mutate(
    GDP_per_capita = round((GDP_MEUR * 1000000) / Population, 0)
  )

Country_indicators_tb
```

```{r}
Country_indicators_tb <- Country_indicators_tb |>
  mutate(
    Gini_coef = ifelse(
      Country_name == "United Kingdom",
      33.5,
      Gini_coef
    )
  )
```

```{r}
write_csv(Country_indicators_tb, file = here("data", "processed", "Country_indicators_tb.csv"))
```
